messages:
Marco: Card declined at a tiny ferry kiosk in Bilbao this morning — no chip fallback and the terminal printed a tiny POS slip that just says 'CX-FERRY 003' and an auth code. I paid with my personal Visa for €49.50. What’s the fastest way to get this reimbursed? My corpcard had a soft-decline earlier this week too.

Aisha: Sorry that happened. For out-of-pocket foreign transit charges we need: (1) merchant name/description (what you have), (2) a photo of the POS slip or vendor receipt, and (3) the personal card statement line showing the charge. Please upload to the Expenses portal and include manager approval. If you can’t upload, paste images here and I will start the manual claim.

Marco: Uploading now — photos: https://imgur.com/a/placeholder (photo shows 'CX-FERRY 003' plus handwritten token). Personal card screenshot attached. I also have a tiny boarding stub but it’s mostly handwritten. I don’t have an itemized VAT invoice.

Sam (manager): Approved — reimburse Marco for the €49.50. @Aisha please process. :thumbsup:

Aisha: Thanks @Sam. Marco — when you file in the portal choose category "Travel — ground/transit", set currency to EUR, expense date 2026-03-20, add note "ferry due to corpcard decline", and attach the POS slip + bank statement line (and boarding stub if you want). I’ll flag it for expedited review and request FX conversion at the bank rate on the charge date.

Marco: Done. Submitted expense ID T-8462 with the three attachments. Quick question — is the handwritten boarding stub required or is the POS slip + personal bank line enough?

Aisha: POS slip + bank statement line is sufficient for sub-€50 transit items per policy. If you have the stub, attach it but not required. Expect reimbursement within ~7 business days after I process. Also I’ll open a corpcard failure ticket with Operations to investigate recurring declines.

expense-bot: New expense submitted (ID: T-8462) by Marco. Status: pending manager approval (approved by Sam). Next step: Finance review. Exchange rate note: will use ECB noon rate for 2026-03-20 for conversion.

Jenny: Heads-up — recent policy update: receipts under €50 for small vendors can be submitted with a clear photo + bank line; itemized receipts are required for meals/client entertainment only. See internal doc: https://redwood-internal/docs/expense-policy#small-vendors

Aisha: Thanks @Jenny. Marco — I’ve marked this as "expedite". If you see any more corpcard soft-declines, ping #eng-finance so we can batch telephony/auth tickets with the card provider. I’ll process T-8462 today.

Marco: Really appreciate it — thanks everyone.
